Aero 1.3: every feature tested on a real PC, voice typing, text in images, Word documents.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.3_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.3_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.3-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.3-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## What's new

- **Voice typing.** A microphone button in the chat box; whisper.cpp turns your speech into text on your PC.
  Attached recordings are transcribed too.
- **Text in images for models that can't see.** Attached images, scanned PDFs and screenshots are read with
  Windows' own OCR.
- **Word documents.** Ask for a Word file and get a real .docx.
- **Fixes from testing every feature**, among them:
  - a model tuned to fill the GPU no longer crashes on its second request (since 1.2.70);
  - typing into apps works;
  - Mod Aero's checks pass again;
  - edits keep Windows line endings.

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md). Test results:
[V1.3_TEST_REPORT](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/docs/V1.3_TEST_REPORT.md).
